state.task: Review this pure timestamp formatter used once to label an already-recorded event. It does not compute deadlines or schedule work.

senior-review:temporal-resilience-audito.instructions: Does the supplied task and evidence satisfy the reviewer's TRIGGER WHEN?

criteria.false: startup/bootstrap cycles (use chicken-egg-detector), cross-service timeout chains (use distributed-flow-auditor), or UI rendering races (use ui-race-auditor).
criteria.true: reviewing timers, schedulers, polling loops, retry/reconnect logic, queues, cron jobs, background workers or watchdogs.
